title: Rubber Duck plugin manifest
description: Manifest (plugin.json) that lives at the root of every Rubber Duck plugin package (.duckplug).

id.description: Stable unique identifier, kebab-case. Used for install dir, settings namespace, and IPC origin.

version.description: Semantic version of this plugin release.

icon.description: Path to an icon within the package (png/svg), relative to the manifest.

hostApiVersion.description: Major version of the host plugin API this plugin targets. The host refuses incompatible plugins.

ui.description: Web-bundle UI shipped with the plugin, served over the plugin:// protocol.

entry.description: Entry HTML file within the package, e.g. ui/index.html.

window.description: Native-window preferences when the UI opens in its own window instead of the hub.

actions.description: Bindable actions the plugin exposes for global shortcuts. Triggering an action calls the sidecar method named by `id` with empty params.

id.description: Sidecar method invoked when the action fires.

sidecars.description: Per-platform native executables the host spawns and talks to over JSON-RPC (stdio).

path.description: Path to the executable within the package, relative to the manifest.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the executable, verified after unpack.

permissions.description: Host capabilities the plugin requests (advisory for now; enforced later).

settingsSchema.description: Optional JSON-schema describing this plugin's settings, rendered by the host.
